summary: All 10 comprehensive backend RLS security tests pass. Fixed HIGH-severity allowlist gap (validate_resource on GET/PATCH), unified hospital ownership key (hospital_key helper), added admin-bootstrap endpoint gated by server-only ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET, narrowed the JWT exception catch. /api/status reachable unauthenticated. Frontend was not modified (scaffold only).

policies_created.nurse_profile: owner_id ownership, hospitals read only via /recruitment/nurses with redaction
policies_created.hospital: owner_id ownership, public read only via /public/hospitals
policies_created.job: hospital_id ownership; nurses may only read published+approved+active by id
policies_created.application: nurse_id owns; hospital owns via job.hospital_id; applicants cannot change status
policies_created.saved_job: owner_id, delete allowed by owner only
policies_created.interview: hospital creates for own jobs; nurse reads only for own applications
policies_created.document: owner_id only; hospitals never read except via explicit business flow (not exposed); admin override

remaining_limitations: No brute-force / rate limiting on auth.
Document endpoint holds metadata only; real file storage should use signed private URLs when introduced.
Frontend NurseConnect UI (dashboards, job search, application flow) not implemented – scaffold only. Backend security is enforced regardless.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests create ephemeral TEST_ / ADMIN_ accounts only.
